title: Welcome to WillKompass!
subtitle:
Your learning journey begins here.
We are very pleased to welcome you to the WillKompass app.
WillKompass accompanies you as you learn, arrive and find your way around Austria.
The app offers you understandable content, courses and information to help you develop new skills and further your personal and professional development.
second_subtitle:
U-N-D is an association of people with different countries of origin, languages ​​and experiences.Many of our team know from their own experience how challenging arriving in a new country can be.

We develop projects that support new immigrants when they arrive and offer orientation in everyday life, learning and in the digital space.For us it's not just about technology, but about making life in Austria more understandable and enabling active participation.

Our work is collaborative, multilingual and practical.It is precisely this diversity that makes our work strong - we develop our offers with people, not just for them.
third_paragraph: Orientation for your life in Austria
third_paragraph_content_start: WillKompass helps you to orientate yourself better in various areas of life, for example:
third_paragraph_content_2: in education, work and professional development
third_paragraph_content_4: in understanding everyday life, rights and obligations
third_paragraph_content_end:
Use the offers to receive valuable information and practical tips that will support you on your personal and professional path.
We wish you much success and joy in learning!
